findings: ZIP 33478 (Jupiter) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.

Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33478 (Jupiter) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
